subject.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs

question: Should this PR land independently, or wait until optional TTS SecretRef startup behavior is settled by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101204 / https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101265?
rationale: The code fix is in the right owner boundary, but adding persona TTS targets changes which credentials are resolved at startup and can expand fail-fast behavior for missing optional TTS keys.

options.title: Require Proof And Coordinate Optional TTS
options.body: Ask for a redacted live TTS/Gateway run and land only once maintainers confirm the optional TTS SecretRef startup semantics are safe for persona paths.

options.title: Accept Current Fail-Fast Expansion
options.body: Merge after proof and green checks while intentionally accepting that missing persona TTS SecretRefs may fail startup under the current SecretRef contract.

options.title: Fold Into Optional TTS Repair
options.body: Pause this PR and have the persona target additions land together with a 101265-style optional-TTS degradation fix.

recommendation.title: Require Proof And Coordinate Optional TTS
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted live TTS/Gateway run and land only once maintainers confirm the optional TTS SecretRef startup semantics are safe for persona paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is centered on the SecretRef runtime and target registry behavior introduced in PR 29580.
